messages:
Theo: quick idea: add a tiny ingress preflight that returns a 'shapeScore' and a recommended "route_action" so routing/console/quota can make better decisions. want minimal surface area.
Mina: agree on minimal API. what are the concrete route_action values?
Theo: proposal: route_action ∈ {fastpath, large_shard, async_batch, reject}. score 0..100. mapping deterministic: <=40 fastpath, 41-70 large_shard, 71-89 async_batch, >=90 reject (unless client opts into async).
Arjun: important: quota semantics. if we split a request server-side we should count units conservatively (sum of parts). also preflight must return an estimated unit_count so console billing can show impact.
Kate: console UX: add a per-tenant "shape score" timeseries, a table of recent auto-splits, and a bucketed histogram of suggested route_action. tie to quota burn rate so SRE/product can tune limits.
Mina: telemetry: emit metrics embed.shapeScore.{p50,p90,p99}, embed.route_action.count, embed.preflight.unit_estimate.sum. sample 0.2% of shapes (dims,items,score) for debug. tag only by tenant_id and region. avoid model variant tag.
Theo: API choices: headers vs callable endpoint. lean towards both: passive headers X-Embed-Score & X-Embed-RouteAction on normal responses, plus POST /v1/embeddings/preflight for explicit checks. prefer path /v1/embeddings/preflight (camelCase).
Arjun: error model: if we return reject, do 413-like immediate response? maybe 422 with structured payload {"reason":"oversize","estimate": ...}. keep semantics stable for SDKs.
Kate: rollout: passive headers on day-1 for everyone. active endpoint behind feature flag (console: embeddings.preflight) with canary tenants. show a small banner in console when preflight is enabled for a tenant.
Mina: routing policy: if large_shard chosen, route to nodes optimized for higher throughput but slightly higher p95 latency. if async_batch, return 202 with job_id and a webhook option. allow clients to opt into transparent server-side splitting; otherwise prefer client-side split_hint to reduce runtime overhead.
Arjun: observability: add dashboard panel showing bytes vs dims scatter colored by route_action, and an alert if async_batch queue depth grows > threshold or if unit_estimate suddenly spikes for a tenant.
telemetry-bot: deploy scheduled: ingress-preflight canary to ring-1 at 2024-12-02T02:30Z. rollback if error_rate > 0.6% over 5m.
Theo: eng-runtime — can you implement estimator as a nonblocking read of Content-Length + dims header (no body parse)? keep cost to <1ms median. add circuit to skip when ingress CPU>65%.
Mina: eng-platform — I'll add feature flag + dashboard mocks. Arjun — please specify exact unit_count formula for billing. Kate — i'll add console banners and canary controls.
Theo: will draft RFC with examples (headers, preflight payload, split_hint formats, error codes) and attach mock dashboard screenshots. ping when RFC is ready. :thumbsup:
